workflow_hints: identified a putative CDK2 phosphorylation site in human TRF2 at Ser365

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment combines affinity purification (AP-MS) of the shelterin complex with phospho-proteomic analysis to identify specific phosphorylation sites (Ser365). Acquisition was DDA using an LTQ Orbitrap Velos.

scope: For protein immunoprecipitation, whole-cell extracts were precleared with protein G Sepharose (Sigma-Aldrich), and one to two miligrams of precleared extract was incubated with antibodies as indicated in main text.
Immunocomplexes were subjected to SDS-PAGE followed by immunoblotting
Coomassie-stained polyacrylamide gel slices were excised from SDS-PAGE gels using a scalpel and processed for mass spectrometry

For protein immunoprecipitation, whole-cell extracts were precleared with protein G Sepharose, and two miligrams of precleared extract from 293 HEK expressing Flag-HA RTEL1, N-Flap RTEL1, or Myc-TRF2 were incubated for 1 hour with anti-HA, anti-GFP or anti-Myc antibodies (4 micrograms of abs/reaction), respectively. Immunocomplexes were incubated with protein G Sepharose for 45minutes, washed 3x in NET buffer and subjected to 10% SDS-PAGE.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry was performed on protein gel slices derived from immunoprecipitated complexes (immunocomplexes) of RTEL1 and TRF2, not on whole cell lysates.

While the paper describes many other perturbations (CDK inhibitors, siRNA, mutants), the PRIDE metadata and MS section specifically link the mass spectrometry to the cell cycle synchronization and λ-phosphatase treatment.
